observations.note: The heading's final plural s is not securely separable; both Groupoïdes and Groupoïde remain possible. The horizontal below its right end belongs to the top of the boxed category symbol below, rather than a demonstrated title underline.

Initial index is 1), without a separate degree sign. The symbol is read S followed by a calligraphic T with subscript top, within a hand-drawn box; the parenthetical expansion is underlined on both lines.
The overwritten word before orienté is read doubtfully as cancelled non. The long low rule under S=empty belongs to the following boxed category symbol, not an underline added to that formula.

A cancelled partial Vari stands above Variantes. The numeric index is thickly overwritten; 1 or 2 remains possible, with the degree circle and closing parenthesis clear. Boxed category superscript is read plus/minus. Lower wording is read classes d'isotopie d'homéom., ne respectant pas l'orientation nécessairement.

Complete arrow formula retained. Its overworked label is read doubtfully as a fraktur-like s; the parenthetical signature below has an opening parenthesis but no secure closing one. The cancelled target begins with a B-like symbol, then braces and plus/minus1; exact subscript placement is uncertain. The cancelled word following groupoïde and the full-versus-abbreviated ending of groupe remain uncertain. Right live notation is ±1, noté [±1].

The first cancelled word has a clear y descender and is read noyau. A separately cancelled compact group is doubtfully est. The short group following the opening parenthesis remains ambiguous between an equals sign and en. The surviving words catégorie fibre and final est precede S calligraphic-T subscript top.

All main dark writing in this prescribed box was read, including indices 2° and 3°, dimension1, both displayed category formulas, empty-set formula and all visible revisions. The small isolated dark mark above the definition is retained as an uncertain 6-like mark.

The three defining conditions stand after a straight vertical separator, not a visibly curly cases brace. The deletion after sous-variété is read doubtfully fermée; the raised replacement is read doubtfully pas compacte. The insertion is not silently converted into a standard compactness condition.
The abbreviation d'homéom. is retained. The final lettering of respectant is overworked and remains doubtful.

The first T-D notation has a heavily retraced lower portion of D. An older cancelled S is possible but not separable with confidence; the TeX retains the state alternatives deleted-S-plus-D versus D alone in place.

Divisé is raised above the cancelled quoted word, read doubtfully sauvage. The parenthesis begun before D initiale de closes after that cancelled word. The following two-line quoted expansion is underlined, with raised quotation strokes rather than guillemets.
The marginal replacement imm. ouverte is above the cancelled parenthetical inclusion pleine; the old phrase remains doubtful under its horizontal strike.
The NB line has a subset-shaped relation, not a normalized arrow. A short downward leader connects the left-hand category to the explanation sous-groupoïde des objets tels que Sigma=empty.

The final sentence literally has de followed by an equals sign. Its displayed letters are read calligraphic T then S, with plus/minus above and top below, although the nearby other notation includes an extra D. No mathematical or notational regularization was applied.

Pale gray contours and brown punctiform marks lie behind the dark text. Their physical status as older front-side drawing or show-through cannot be established from this box. A separate, explicitly uncertain TikZ tracing preserves visible local runs, unlettered small rings and flecks, without assigning graph topology, arrow directions, or numerical vertex labels. Geometry and continuity through dark handwriting remain uncertain.
